title: Density of Products of Solutions and the Linearized Calderón Problem in an Analytic Background
summary: We study the linearization, with respect to zeroth-order perturbations, of the local Dirichlet-to-Neumann map of a formally self-adjoint elliptic operator $P=-Δ_g+Q$ on a compact Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$ of dimension $n\geq 2$ with boundary, where $Q$ is of order at most one. Near a boundary point where the boundary, metric, and $P$ are analytic, we show that the linearized map is a classical analytic pseudodifferential operator of order $-1$ if and only if the zeroth-order perturbation $q$ extends analytically across the boundary.
